premiseCorrection.claimInTask: The RM3 React button lives in role-model-router/packages/ui/src.
premiseCorrection.finding: No React Button component exists in role-model-router/packages/ui/src, and none exists anywhere in the worktree or its git history (git ls-files has no button module; `git log --all -- role-model-router/packages/ui/src/button.tsx` is empty). The RM3 button contract in this repository lives in the runtime-ui app as token-driven class helpers rendered inline: primaryButtonClassName, primaryButtonBlockClassName, secondaryButtonClassName, compactFieldButtonClassName, compactFieldButtonEmphasisClassName, utilityButtonClassName (role-model-router/apps/runtime-ui/app/lib/design-system.ts:1247-1265), with the written grammar in role-model-router/apps/runtime-ui/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:379-384.
premiseCorrection.whatIPorted: The actual RM3 contract: those class helpers plus the disabled/active-scale grammar they encode. I did not invent a React-derived API.
premiseCorrection.documentedConflict: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:381 says primary actions use the accent blue family with pill radius and `11px 22px` padding, but the live class helpers use `rounded-[var(--rm-radius-field)]`, `h-[36px]`, `px-3.5` (primary) / `h-[34px]`, `px-4` (compact). I preserved the live helpers, because they are what the React app actually renders; the doc line is stale relative to code.

preserved: variant vocabulary: primary, secondary, compactField (RM3 compact field), compactFieldEmphasis (compact primary emphasis), utility; class strings copied verbatim from design-system.ts:1248-1265.
primary block form: primaryButtonBlockClassName's `w-full` is available as `block` and only for the primary variant (design-system.ts:1252).

size vocabulary: RM3 encodes size in the variant (36px primary/secondary/utility vs 34px compact field), so the primitive holds those fixed heights and does not invent a separate size prop; asserted by Scene class checks.

disabled behaviour: native `disabled` plus `aria-disabled`, click handler omitted entirely (mirrors vendor/foldkit/packages/ui/src/button/index.ts:45-46) and Scene refuses to click a disabled element (vendor/foldkit/packages/foldkit/src/test/scene.ts:1908-1916). Disabled styling `disabled:opacity-60` is preserved from the RM3 helpers where those helpers define it (all but utility).

accessible name: a button is named by text children; icon-only usage requires `ariaLabel`; the primitive throws rather than rendering an unnamed control. RM3's app has 46 `aria-label` usages on interactive elements (e.g. app/routes/control-benchmark.tsx:864), so icon-only naming is an existing RM3 practice.

token-driven classes: RM3 tokens appear verbatim (`--rm-radius-field`, `--rm-surface`, `--rm-panel`, `--rm-border-strong`, `bg-primary`), and the test asserts representative classes including `rounded-[var(--rm-radius-field)]`, `h-[36px]`, `h-[34px]`.
click dispatch: the caller supplies a Message and the Foldkit runtime dispatches it; the test proves a click increments the model through `Scene.click` + `Scene.expectHandled`.
notPreserved: Loading state: RM3 has no button loading contract to preserve. There is no loading prop, and `aria-busy` appears on no button in runtime-ui (grep over app/**/*.tsx: 0 hits). The primitive does not invent an isLoading API; this is a deliberate non-port, not a gap.
Active/pressed scale: the class grammar includes `active:scale-95` (kept verbatim), but Scene does not simulate the CSS `:active` pseudo-class; only the class presence is asserted.

React prop plumbing: there is no React component to mirror, by the premise correction above. The Foldkit equivalent is: `h` builder supplied by the runtime, Message instead of onEvent props, `block`/`variant` config instead of className composition by callers.

Its Scene test lives in role-model-router/packages/foldkit/test because the controller installed happy-dom + vitest in packages/foldkit and that package owns the built Foldkit wrapper; packages/ui has no link to @role-model-router/foldkit and no happy-dom, so a test there could not resolve the vendored Scene harness. The test imports the wrapper's built scene/message/vitest entries by relative path and the primitive by relative path, and runs with `--environment happy-dom` like the vendored configs (vendor/foldkit/packages/foldkit/vitest.config.ts:5, packages/ui/vitest.config.ts:10).
